title: Audio and Picture Synchronization in Motion-Picture Film Relative to Leaders for Television and Theatrical Presentation for Analog Magnetic and Photographic Records
scope: It is the purpose of this practice to standardize the photographic and magnetic synchronizing signals and their position relative to the SMPTE Leaders for Television and Theatrical Presentation, as specified in SMPTE ST 55:2011 and SMPTE ST 301:2005.
